name: Declared app simulation receipt gates the attribution badge
trigger: A deterministic test-world run completes the required app.yaml scenarios and the Nexus app host serves the resulting static app snapshot.
observe: required scenarios are read from app.yaml
simulation proof receipt is stored atomically with its app receipt and events
current-source passing proof binds the owned badge fingerprint
missing, failed, stale, unmeasured, malformed-script and rollback-failure paths withhold or omit proof
expected: The badge is visible only for a current passing proof; browser parsing never attaches its fingerprint to text, template content or script-inert markup.
